structure: Part 19, Private transporter: 22 traces from transporters.fit.spec.js lines 794-991 in four describe blocks: rendering and optionality (5 tests, lines 799-865), required validations (7 parameterised tests, line 875), format validations (8 parameterised max-length tests at line 905 plus the out-of-list country test at line 928) and persistence (1 test, line 958). Every trace signs in with the stub, starts a notification, completes origin, commodity and arrival, then goes Transporter details > Add a transporter > Choose a transporter type > Private transporter > Save and continue to land on /transporters/add/private ('Add private transporter'). Each trace was unzipped and mined from its action log, DOM snapshots (form fields, labels, hints, error summary, inline errors, preserved values) and network log (POST status and redirect). Claims cover the page's chrome (caption, heading, title, intro, back link), all nine fields with their labels, optional markers, input types, widths and autocomplete, the country list, the contact-details heading and order, the phone hint, the single primary button, blank-save optionality, all seven required-field errors, all eight max-length errors, the out-of-list country error, error-page behaviour (title prefix, summary links, focus, preserved values) and persistence of a complete record.
